canonical_project: Covilha Data Center Campus (Asterion / Altice Portugal / Portugal Telecom)
owner: Asterion Industrial Partners (acquired from Altice Portugal, EUR 120M)
notes: Covilha (Castelo Branco district; manifest label 'White Castle') data center campus built 2013 by Portugal Telecom; 6.8 MW installed capacity operational with modular expansion potential up to 75 MW within the campus and ~175 MW on adjacent power-secured land; Uptime Institute tier awards; Altice/MEO remains anchor customer. Asterion official release (A) for capacity; DCD (B) for acquisition.
